description: Demolition of outbuilding and the construction of a two storey side extension, a single storey rear extension and relocation of the entrance to the front
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The proposed two-storey rear extension by reason of its&nbsp;scale, mass, and design, would not appear subservient to the host dwelling, compromise the openness of the corner plot and&nbsp;unbalance the symmetry and uniformity&nbsp;across the host terrace row. Additionally, the proposed&nbsp;relocation of the entrance to the front would the symmetry and uniformity across the host terrace row and be at odds with the character and appearance of the overall streetscene as the front entrances of the surrounding dwellings&nbsp;within the Becontree Estate are generally off‑centre and framed by carefully arranged window groupings that create a distinctive and balanced appearance.&nbsp;</span></span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(245, 245, 245);">As such, the proposed development is contrary to:</span></p><p style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);"><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">- National Planning Policy Framework</span>&nbsp;(NPPF) (December 2024)<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);"><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt; line-height: 14.98px;">- Polies D1, D4, D5, D6 and HC1 of the London Plan (March 2021)</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);"></p><p style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);"><span style="font-weight: 700;">-&nbsp;</span><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Policies&nbsp;</span>DMD1, DMD4, DMD5,&nbsp;<span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">SP2 and SPP6 of&nbsp;</span>the London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan (September 2024)</p><p style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)</p>
borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
